title: Bog Basic calisthenics strength
author: Steve Searle
desc: Unleash your potential with the 8-week "Bog Basic Calisthenics Strength" program, designed to build strength using your bodyweight. With 24 sessions over two months, you'll engage in a variety of exercises like Pull-Ups, L-Sits, and Hanging Leg Raises, all tailored for both novice and intermediate lifters. Each workout, lasting approximately 20 minutes, focuses on enhancing your overall fitness and core strength, making it perfect for at-home training. Get ready to transform your body and elevate your fitness journey!

ex.note: Stand on an elevated surface & hold a weight, forward fold as much as possible

ss.note: Sit up and perform single leg raises per leg, make sure to sit as forward as possible avoiding opening up the body more than 90 degrees

Don't perform this exact exercise all the time, mostly go into an L-Sit position, Raise your body so your bum is hovering in the air and feet touching the ground, using your hands slide back and forth
